The evidence suggests a chain of targets, where Bremelanotide influences Gamma-secretase, which in turn targets WI-38. This implies that Bremelanotide may exert its effects on WI-38 via a mechanism involving Gamma-secretase. The integration of these relationships highlights a potential regulatory pathway where Bremelanotide could influence WI-38 through a series of enzymatic interactions, potentially affecting cellular processes in the target cell. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Bremelanotide and WI-38, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
